name: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Ltd
title: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Ltd - 538668 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mumbai redevelopment developer with no supply-side disclosure; FY26 revenue INR46.2 cr (+15.8%) but PAT fell ~43% and operating cash flow negative, with pipeline claims unquantified by capacity or cost discipline.

triggers.label: Operating cash flow negative despite profits
triggers.quote: Despite profitability, our operating cash flow has been negative.

triggers.label: GDV to double in three years, unquantified
triggers.quote: In the coming three years, and I will not give you a number, but you can expect us doubling the GDV overall.

triggers.label: Andheri pressure from multiple launches
triggers.quote: there has been pressure on the Andheri market because of nultiple launches.

guidance.quote: planning to add three to five new projects annually
an estimated GDV exceeding INR2,100 crores of Mumbai and adjoining markets
the date blocked for the launch is 22nd of June

red_flags.label: PAT down ~43% and EBITDA margin 29% to 22%
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margin has also declined from 29% to 22% in FY26.

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow
red_flags.quote: Despite profitability, our operating cash flow has been negative.

red_flags.label: Vague land and approvals timelines
red_flags.quote: approvals have slowed down over the last three- four months.

evasions.quote: giving you a land holding as an answer for a redevelopment specialist doesn't make sense for us.
honestly I'm not allowed to talk numbers at this stage.

summary.headline: Meghna Infracon FY26 revenue rose 15.84% to INR46.2 crore, but PAT fell 4.28% as carry-over securities profits lapsed.
summary.overview: Management described the company as transitioning from Naysaa Securities to a Mumbai-focused redevelopment developer. FY26 revenue from operations was INR46.2 crore versus INR39.88 crore, and Q4 revenue was INR18.48 crore, up 52.47% YoY. FY26 PAT was INR5.59 crore, down about 4.28% YoY, which management attributed to the absence of carry-over profits from the earlier securities business. Management guided to a sharp increase in GDV and profitability over the coming years, with current GDV pipeline stated above INR2,100 crore.

financial_highlights.change: +15.84% YoY vs INR39.88 crore in FY25
+52.47% YoY vs INR12.12 crore in Q4 FY25
Increase of about INR6.92 crore YoY as stated
Down from 29%, per analyst question; not disputed by management
Up from INR46,822 per sq ft, per analyst question

segments.name: Residential redevelopment (Mumbai)
segments.commentary: Five ongoing projects including Riviera, Rivaan, Pranam (Versova), Manju Villa and Joshville (Santa Cruz); ongoing portfolio about 290,000 sq ft and INR280 crore GDV. Goregaon projects 70-80% sold.

segments.name: Commercial (Meghna One IT Park, Wagle Estate Thane)
segments.commentary: Wagle Estate commercial project, GDV INR300 crore, launch date blocked for 22 June 2026 subject to RERA. Meghna One is a Grade A gold-certified green building.

guidance_outlook: Launches May-Dec 2026: Wagle Estate commercial (INR300 crore GDV), Khar residential (INR60 crore), Bandra West residential (INR240 crore), Juhu/Vile Parle West residential (INR50 crore); next launches adding over INR600 crore GDV by September 2026.
Upcoming portfolio GDV stated above INR2,100 crore; management aims to at least double it over the next two years, without giving a number.
Riviera OC expected within a month; Rivaan targeted for completion by December 2026 versus RERA deadline March 2027.
Management expects PAT to improve this year as project profits begin to be booked.
Approvals for seven to eight further projects with signed sign-ups expected in Q2 or Q3 2026 after BMC-level slowdown.
Acquisitions outside the redevelopment model to stay below 20% of GDV.
capex_capacity: Rivaan: 20-storey building, 17th of 20 slabs under construction; finishing on lower floors has started.
Kandivali project (over INR500 crore GDV): land registration done; height approval pending from MoD; company open to debt on this project, otherwise self-funded or pre-sales funded.
Construction area of current and upcoming projects to launch by December 2026 to exceed 1 million sq ft, with a similar increase expected over the next two years.
Biophilic facade design cited as cutting execution time by about 10-15%.
demand_pricing: Pre-sales typically 20-30% of inventory at each launch; Joshville about 70% pre-sold with about 15% inventory left.
Andheri under pressure from multiple launches; registrations on over 30% of Andheri pipeline expected in coming quarter.
Bandra/Santa Cruz/Khar project more than 70% sold.
Prabhadevi-Dadar sea-facing apartments selling at INR1.2-1.4 lakh per sq ft; company says its feasibility cost is much lower, enabling discounted entry pricing.
Price volatility in steel and cement: company seeks fixed-price contracts; management expects little impact on premium launches.
Realisation improvement attributed to premium project mix and maturing projects.

qa_highlights.question: Reason for the about 12% rise in realisation: pricing or mix?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited a shift to more premium projects and maturing projects from prior-year launches, which lifted collections.

qa_highlights.question: Unsold inventory across ongoing projects and FY27 outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Riviera has one unit left; Rivaan six unsold units with bookings pending registration; Pranam 30-35% conversion this quarter; Manju Villa three units; Joshville about 15% left.

qa_highlights.question: Which of the upcoming projects launch in FY27 and approval timelines?
qa_highlights.answer: Wagle Estate launch 22 June 2026 pending RERA by end-June; Khar RERA delayed by pending approvals, bookings in Q2 2027; Bandra West launch Q2 2027 with bookings from Q3 2026; Juhu/Vile Parle slipping 15-20 days into Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Kandivali approvals and funding plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Land registration done; awaiting height approval from MoD. Self-funded so far; open to project-level debt, with pre-sales and accruals as main funding.

qa_highlights.question: Why did PAT and EBITDA margin decline?
qa_highlights.answer: Securities carry-over profits ended after the 2024 transition; project lifecycle delayed profit booking; higher delivery costs and acquisition costs compressed margins.

qa_highlights.question: Why is operating cash flow negative despite profit?
qa_highlights.answer: Company aims to stay nearly debt-free; cash went into acquisitions of future projects that management expects to lift GDV and profit.

qa_highlights.question: Pace of project addition and GDV growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management aims to at least double GDV over the next two to three years, citing INR2,100 crore pipeline; no specific number given on project additions.

risks_watch: Approval delays at BMC/MoD level: seven to eight projects waiting, Khar RERA pending, Juhu/Vile Parle slipping.
Negative operating cash flow and reliance on pre-sales for funding; Kandivali may need debt or JV partner.
Margin pressure: EBITDA margin fell from 29% to 22% in FY26; acquisition costs and project mix weigh on profitability.
Andheri supply pressure from multiple launches.
Steel and cement price volatility on contracts that are mostly fixed price.
Rivaan completion target of December 2026 versus RERA deadline of March 2027.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on pipeline and demand, but evasive on quantified targets (declined to give specific project-addition numbers or land holdings). Cautious on approval timelines, with several launch dates shifting.
key_quotes: So to be very honest, there is not a dip in demand. Demand actually is impacted of by supply more than anything else.
We are nearly debt-zero. We have always maintained that we want to remain debt-zero and that's why you will see a negative impact.
In the coming three years, and I will not give you a number, but you can expect us doubling the GDV overall.

adds.what: Wagle Estate commercial project, INR300 crore GDV (launch blocked 22 June 2026, subject to RERA)
Khar residential project, INR60 crore GDV (launch May-Dec 2026)
Bandra West residential project, INR240 crore GDV (launch May-Dec 2026)
Juhu/Vile Parle West residential project, INR50 crore GDV (launch May-Dec 2026)

growth.why: Management guides to GDV doubling over three years (unquantified) and PAT improvement this year as project profits are booked, backed by a dated launch pipeline (Wagle Estate INR300 crore on 22 June 2026, plus Khar, Bandra West and Juhu/VP West launches by Dec 2026) and a stated INR2,100 crore+ GDV pipeline, though no revenue growth number is given and the doubling target is unquantified.
